heard: Built for 21 months, it flew for over 30 years. Most people think deep space probes fail early, but Pioneer 10 shattered every limit. In March 1972, an Atlas Centaur rocket launched the historic mission from Earth. The spacecraft became the first to safely navigate through the treacherous asteroid belt. It survived brutal Jovian radiation to capture stunning close-up views of the Great Red Spot. Bolted to its antenna strut was a gold anodized plaque designed by Carl Sagan and Frank Drake. The message carried drawings of nude humans and a map pointing back to Earth. Today, this silent ghost ship drifts toward the constellation Taurus after operating for decades.
